title: nodecode/weekly/1
description: One page of counts an organism sends nodecode.ai once a week when its operator chose to share. Every field is listed here and nothing else is sent: no prompt, path, file, hostname, session id or install id. The nonce is minted per page and links nothing across pages. `nodecode` prints the next page with /qa show.

nonce.description: minted for this page; the collector keeps it two weeks to drop a redelivery, then forgets it

version.description: the build, as nodecode --version prints it

platform.description: arch-os as a release names itself: x86_64-linux, arm64-darwin

since.description: the window's start: the previous page's end, or the moment sharing was chosen

rounds.description: one entry per provider and model that answered a round in the window

fallbacks.description: rounds that failed over to another model

cached_tokens.description: cache-read input tokens, to the nearest thousand

ttft_ms.description: median time to first token; absent when no round measured one

failed.description: count per failure class: the condition type's name, package dropped

tools.description: one entry per tool called in the window

duration_ms.description: median body time; absent when unmeasured

issues.description: what the model reported through report_issue, by tool and symptom; the note's text never rides here

crashes.description: count per condition class of the process-ending reports the stdio log holds
